title: The first frost on the flats
logline: The flats with frost on the mud's ridges, the channels steaming, the pup's two-one prints black in the white. December's first page. The chimney across the bay with frost on its ladder.

panels.composition: Mudflats with frost on the mud ridges and steam rising off the channels, a three-legged dog's prints dark in the white, a small three-legged dog ahead, the chimney far off.
